question:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.

Due to the accident, she had a deep ______ on her arm.
solution:
The correct answer is '**wound**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**wound**" refers to an injury, especially one where the skin is cut or broken. (घाव)
 
• In the given sentence, the context is an accident that caused a deep injury on her arm.
 
• The other options: "**wind**," "**wounded**," and "**wand**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Due to the accident, she had a deep wound__ on her arm.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Wind (हवा)**: Refers to moving air.
 
• **Wounded (घायल)**: Refers to a person or animal who has been injured.
 
• **Wand (छड़ी)**: Refers to a slender stick or rod, typically used in magical contexts.
